lines.value: Imported from shadcn-ui/taxonomy — a Next.js (App Router) app: An open source application built using the new router, server components and everything new in Next.js 13.. Main sections: Home, Slug, Blog, Dashboard, Billing, Settings, Docs, Editor, Guides, Login, Pricing, Register. Structure: 14 pages, 94 components, 7 API routes, 14 data models.

fidelityFeatures.name: nextjs-app project
fidelityFeatures.reason: Prism regenerates your app as a node graph (the graph is the app) — it does not run your framework build. Structure, copy, and brand are carried into the regenerated app.

fidelityFeatures.name: 14 page routes → 12 hubs
fidelityFeatures.reason: Each page route becomes a hub in the regenerated Prism app.

fidelityFeatures.name: 5 dynamic routes (e.g. /[...slug])
fidelityFeatures.reason: A dynamic route becomes one hub template; the per-item data that fills it comes from a data source you connect (needs-you below).

fidelityFeatures.name: 8 layout(s)
fidelityFeatures.reason: Shared layouts map onto Prism global slots (header/footer/nav), not arbitrary React layout components.

fidelityFeatures.name: 94 React components
fidelityFeatures.reason: Your components inform the regenerated layout, but Prism authors scene NODES (3D-native), not your React code verbatim — the graph is the app.

fidelityFeatures.name: 23 copy strings (headings, CTAs)
fidelityFeatures.reason: Your headings and calls-to-action seed the regenerated text nodes.

fidelityFeatures.name: Brand palette
fidelityFeatures.reason: Not enough distinct colours were found in the repo, so the "Prism Premium default" premium direction supplies the palette. Edit it in your brief.

fidelityFeatures.name: Typography (Inter as Font Sans)
fidelityFeatures.reason: Your font choices map to the nearest Prism type classification (display/text). Exact webfonts can be wired at ship time.

fidelityFeatures.name: 14 brand image assets
fidelityFeatures.reason: Image assets are referenced by path; upload them (or connect the repo asset host) so they render in the regenerated app.

fidelityFeatures.name: Prisma / SQL DB integration
fidelityFeatures.reason: Becomes a Prism capability reference you authorize. No credentials were read from the repo (dep: prisma).

fidelityFeatures.name: Vercel Analytics integration
fidelityFeatures.reason: Becomes a Prism capability reference you authorize. No credentials were read from the repo (dep: @vercel/analytics).

fidelityFeatures.name: Auth.js integration
fidelityFeatures.reason: Auth is re-established in Prism — you connect the provider fresh; no credentials are carried from the repo (secrets never import).

fidelityFeatures.name: Postmark integration
fidelityFeatures.reason: Becomes a Prism capability reference you authorize. No credentials were read from the repo (dep: postmark).

fidelityFeatures.name: Stripe integration
fidelityFeatures.reason: Becomes a Prism capability reference you authorize. No credentials were read from the repo (dep: stripe).

fidelityFeatures.name: 14 data models (Account, Session, User)
fidelityFeatures.reason: Prism does not migrate your database. The models are captured so you can connect your data source; the schema itself stays where it lives.

fidelityFeatures.name: 7 API endpoints
fidelityFeatures.reason: Server routes are not transplanted (contamination-aware: Prism never runs unverified code). They are listed so you can rebuild them as Prism backend capabilities.
